report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with fatigue described as a constant drain on energy that persists despite good sleep and reduces motivation, along with swollen lymph nodes in the neck (under jawline and base of neck, firm but not painful, stable for months). They also report night sweats. Their last blood test showed slightly elevated white blood cell count. They have a history of well-controlled hypertension on amlodipine. They are open to medical evaluation and expect tests to determine the cause.
